appearance_facts.fact: Chart title reads 'Additional Top Stores: Ad Spend vs Sales'. This is a scatter plot, not a time series.
Five blue circular markers are plotted in a tight, roughly linear upward band from lower-left to upper-right, indicating a strong positive correlation.
Store 6 is the lowest point on both axes (approx. x=30, y=60).
Store 10 is the highest point on both axes (approx. x=70, y=157).
Stores 7, 8, and 9 fall between Store 6 and Store 10, maintaining the linear trend.
